name: s10i-claude-plugins
description: Collection of Claude plugins by Imran Shaikh (@shaikh-imran)

plugins.name: noti-toasti-windows
plugins.description: Windows toast banner notifications with sound for Claude Code when user input is needed or notifications are triggered (supports Windows & WSL)

plugins.name: noti-toasti-mac
plugins.description: Native macOS banner notifications with sound for Claude Code when user input is needed or notifications are triggered, including agent name and path context

plugins.name: metero
plugins.description: Claude Mod showing context meter above the input in Claude Code with token usage and cost in USD

plugins.name: namer-cr
plugins.description: Asks for the session name and assigns a random color on startup in Claude Code
